notes.title: June 18th: Information on the major update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Gleamlight and being so patient.
We have made the following update today. 

●Art Expression Enhancement
Not only have we enhanced the glass expression and transparency, we’ve adjusted the brightness and lighting of the entire screen.
You can now be able to explore a deeper and more beautiful stained glass world.

●Play Tips Display
Play tips are now displayed when you get stuck in progress or when you acquire new skills.

●Game Difficulty Adjustment
Adjusted the difficulty of the game to make it easier to play.

●Story Scenes Enhancement
Strengthened some scenes to the progress of the story.
You will be able to experience more amazing stories than ever before.

●Partial Control Adjustment
Added camera operation and changed some of the in-game actions.
You can now look beyond the map and attack while avoiding enemies attacks.
These will make your adventure more comfortable indeed.

[previewyoutube=yD5-dCU28Dg;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy the fascinating world of “Gleamlight” with artistic expression enhanced by this major update.
